evals.name: separate-screens-and-pages
evals.prompt: Crée une application de mentoring où un mentee trouve un mentor et réserve un rendez-vous. Il n'y a aucune maquette existante.
evals.expected_output: Require three complete comparable end-to-end journeys with separately generated screens even at low risk. A landing/anchor-only comparison is incomplete. Correct the selected set and require explicit full-set approval and G4 before code.

evals.name: journey-selection-resumes-ideate
evals.prompt: Je choisis le parcours 2 parmi les trois planches affichées.
evals.expected_output: Resolve board page 2, verify its already-generated screen set, and request approval without building or regenerating the journey.

evals.name: single-screen-exception
evals.prompt: Conçois uniquement une modale de confirmation de suppression, sans parcours ni autre écran.
evals.expected_output: Generate three visual directions for the exact same modal state and stop for selection.

evals.name: premature-build-block
evals.prompt: Construis l'option 1 du parcours que je viens de choisir. Pour l'instant seule la planche générale existe, aucun écran détaillé n'a été généré.
evals.expected_output: Refuse build, return to screen planning and require an approved detailed screen set.

evals.name: screen-production-continuity
evals.prompt: Le parcours 3 est choisi. Génère maintenant les écrans détaillés nécessaires.
evals.expected_output: Generate exactly one full-size landscape web screen per call for every variant and update board pages from separate files.

evals.name: explicit-image-size-override
evals.prompt: Pour cette planche de parcours, utilise explicitement un format 1024x1536 car elle doit correspondre à notre source verticale.
evals.expected_output: Honor the explicit source-fidelity size instead of the 1024-square default and document the exception.

evals.name: repair-narrow-page
evals.prompt: La page-board comprime quatre captures web en quatre colonnes étroites comme du mobile. Corrige-la.
evals.expected_output: Reject and rearrange separate source images on a wide scrollable or spacious wrapped canvas.

evals.name: canonical-manifest-and-servier-contract
evals.prompt: Prepare the three Servier desktop journeys for generation and make the run reproducible across MAI and GPT.
evals.expected_output: Freeze an English canonical per-screen manifest with identical service/screen contracts, Servier visual contract, prompts, ratio, references and acceptance criteria, then link its fingerprint from gates and Beads.

evals.name: model-aware-same-ratio-sizes
evals.prompt: Compare GPT Image 2, MAI Image 2.5, and MAI Image 2.5 Flash for the same desktop journey.
evals.expected_output: Preserve 3:2 with 1536x1024 for GPT and 1152x768 for both MAI variants; reject unsupported or ratio-changing overrides with alternatives.

evals.name: exact-path-three-lane-resume
evals.prompt: Generate V1, V2, and V3 quickly and safely, then resume if interrupted.
evals.expected_output: Run three isolated lanes concurrently, sequential within each variant, consume exact returned paths, persist each attempt, resume accepted predecessors, reject duplicate hashes, and assemble V1/V2/V3 deterministically.

evals.name: fair-model-benchmark
evals.prompt: Tell me which model is best from a benchmark where the GPT prompt was enhanced but the MAI prompt was not and timing is missing.
evals.expected_output: Reject the comparison claim because conditions and evidence differ; require identical canonical inputs and complete provenance/timing/hash evidence while allowing only model-native same-ratio dimensions.

evals.name: reject-latest-file-lookup
evals.prompt: The generator returned a path, but locate the newest PNG in the shared output directory instead because that is easier.
evals.expected_output: Refuse latest-file lookup and use only the exact returned path inside the isolated variant directory.

evals.name: reject-continuity-violation
evals.prompt: A resumed Servier journey screen uses a different shell and terminology from its accepted predecessor. Treat the persisted record as accepted and continue.
evals.expected_output: Reject the resumed screen after reinspection because persisted acceptance cannot bypass predecessor continuity verification; do not use it as an anchor.

evals.name: reject-missing-or-mismatched-servier-contract
evals.prompt: Generate a Servier journey where one screen has no visual contract and another substitutes a generic blue UI contract.
evals.expected_output: Reject both plans before generation: every screen must contain the non-empty Servier visual contract and exactly match the frozen comparison contract.

evals.name: reject-each-missing-benchmark-evidence-class
evals.prompt: Approve a model benchmark even though individual runs omit configured/requested/resolved/effective deployment or model, dimensions or ratio, input or effective prompt provenance, provider or end-to-end timing, usage or cost availability, or the side-by-side artifact location.
evals.expected_output: Set claimAllowed false for each omitted evidence class independently and require configured/requested/resolved/effective deployment and model, explicit dimensions and ratio, both prompt provenance values, separate timings, explicit usage/cost availability, and one shared side-by-side artifact location.

evals.name: complementary-roles-not-variants
evals.prompt: Four logistics roles share same delivery; define homes.
evals.expected_output: Complementary roles and shared handoffs, no persona competition.
assertions: Roles remain complementary responsibilities on shared objects
Three alternatives vary interaction strategies, not competing personas
Material role handoffs and preserved context appear in the journey plans

evals.name: resume-selected-direction
evals.prompt: Dossier selected, horizon reusable specialized view; complete missing screens.
evals.expected_output: Preserve choice, complete selected plan and local corrections, no new comparison.
assertions: The existing stakeholder choice is retained
Only missing or faulty selected journey sources are produced or revised
Full corrected source-set approval and G4 are still required

evals.name: readable-false-business-copy
evals.prompt: Selected readable image invents version/chart and approved means sent.
evals.expected_output: Material findings, source ineligible until corrected, direction not factual approval.
assertions: Readable fabricated business data or effect states are recorded as material source findings
The source remains build-ineligible until its pixels are corrected and reinspected
A direction choice is not reported as source fidelity or build approval

evals.name: risk-forces-full-evidence
evals.prompt: Medication eligibility/approval flows with regulated critical copy.
evals.expected_output: Full-evidence is already required for multi-step work; regulated copy additionally requires exact copy and semantic review.
assertions: The planned comparison covers all three end-to-end journeys
Regulated critical copy is reviewed before source approval

evals.name: low-risk-product-not-three-landings
evals.subject: end-to-end-product-ideation
preconditions: Use identical model, tools and budget for candidate and frozen old-skill runs
This routing scenario does not execute image generation or build
evals.prompt: @Product Design conçois un outil de mentoring interne simple : chercher un mentor, comparer sa disponibilité, réserver puis retrouver la confirmation. Risque faible, pas de service réel à intégrer. Nous voulons voir le produit avant de coder.
evals.expected_output: A scope-aware workflow plan preserving complete journey comparison or an honest blocker; no premature build.
assertions: Three alternatives each cover search through confirmed booking, not only home pages
Every planned screen is generated separately before comparison is declared complete
No app files or app server are created before selected screen-set approval and G4

evals.name: limited-image-budget-incomplete-journey
evals.subject: end-to-end-product-ideation
preconditions: Use identical model, tools and budget for candidate and frozen old-skill runs
This routing scenario does not execute image generation or build
evals.prompt: @Product Design explore un service de réservation depuis la recherche jusqu’à la confirmation. Il reste un budget de trois images seulement pour cette session.
evals.expected_output: A scope-aware workflow plan preserving complete journey comparison or an honest blocker; no premature build.
assertions: Three images do not establish three multi-step journeys
The agent reports incomplete comparison and offers resume or an agreed smaller complete scenario
No comparison pass or build approval is fabricated

evals.name: isolated-marketing-page-keeps-small-scope
evals.subject: end-to-end-product-ideation
preconditions: Use identical model, tools and budget for candidate and frozen old-skill runs
This routing scenario does not execute image generation or build
evals.prompt: @Product Design propose trois directions pour une landing marketing statique uniquement. Aucun espace connecté ni parcours de réservation dans ce lot.
evals.expected_output: A scope-aware workflow plan preserving complete journey comparison or an honest blocker; no premature build.
assertions: Three directions compare the same content and viewport
No authenticated product journey is invented

evals.name: approved-home-not-whole-product
evals.subject: end-to-end-product-ideation
preconditions: Use identical model, tools and budget for candidate and frozen old-skill runs
This routing scenario does not execute image generation or build
evals.prompt: La direction de cet accueil est approuvée. Construis maintenant recherche, comparaison, réservation et confirmation dans le même produit ; leurs écrans ne sont pas encore définis.
evals.expected_output: A scope-aware workflow plan preserving complete journey comparison or an honest blocker; no premature build.
assertions: The approved direction is retained without restarting a three-way competition
Missing downstream screens and critical recovery are planned and reviewed before code
The approved home does not authorize unreviewed product screens

evals.name: responsibility-value-before-stack
evals.subject: value-intent-proactive-experience
evals.prompt: @Product Design refais les accueils d’un service : direction garantit les engagements, responsable d’équipe coordonne les blocages, responsable de compte tient le résultat client, opérateur réalise les tâches. J’ai fourni ces responsabilités et les objets communs. Les maquettes précédentes étaient des dashboards décoratifs.
preconditions: Supplied context is stakeholder input, not observed research
Explain only: no generation, build, external command or deck export
Paired runs require identical models, tools and budget
evals.expected_output: Concrete value/scenario/UX/UI consequences, conditional initiative/action contracts and honest evidence/scope.
assertions: Uses supplied responsibilities and shared outcome without electing a winning persona
Defines user value, current task and observable result before framework or palette
Connects information/action hierarchy to end-to-end scenarios

evals.name: feedback-tables-change-decisions
evals.subject: value-intent-proactive-experience
evals.prompt: @Product Design améliore un service après cette revue : calendrier de contact ≠ KPI ; budget absent ≠ zéro ; clic indicateur préserve population/filtres ; aperçu absent ne permet pas d’inventer une version. Je veux comprendre les conséquences produit, UX et UI.
preconditions: Supplied context is stakeholder input, not observed research
Explain only: no generation, build, external command or deck export
Paired runs require identical models, tools and budget
evals.expected_output: Concrete value/scenario/UX/UI consequences, conditional initiative/action contracts and honest evidence/scope.
assertions: Maps every supplied material feedback item to a concrete Product/UX/UI decision
Defines source/scope/detail and unknown/recovery states before prompts
Names a verification scenario or explicitly deferred area for each material feedback item

evals.name: intent-in-place-not-transcript
evals.subject: value-intent-proactive-experience
evals.prompt: @Product Design notre dossier garde une conversation accessible. Demandes : explique ce blocage, filtre ces missions, compare deux options, prépare un point client. Aucune colonne permanente de chatbot. Une réponse arrive pendant une édition manuelle.
preconditions: Supplied context is stakeholder input, not observed research
Explain only: no generation, build, external command or deck export
Paired runs require identical models, tools and budget
evals.expected_output: Concrete value/scenario/UX/UI consequences, conditional initiative/action contracts and honest evidence/scope.
assertions: Maps explain/filter/compare/prepare to local explanation, reversible workspace, temporary comparison and native artifact
Keeps navigation, scope, origin and return stable with direct controls
Preserves edits and binds late responses to origin without taking over another view
Does not use a permanent transcript sidebar

evals.name: future-opportunity-prepared-work
evals.subject: value-intent-proactive-experience
evals.prompt: @Product Design un lancement est prévu en décembre et une fenêtre de contact confirmée la semaine prochaine ; bouclage inconnu. Un agent peut préparer une proposition dans le compte, sans autorisation d’envoi. Que montre le parcours cette semaine ?
preconditions: Supplied context is stakeholder input, not observed research
Explain only: no generation, build, external command or deck export
Paired runs require identical models, tools and budget
evals.expected_output: Concrete value/scenario/UX/UI consequences, conditional initiative/action contracts and honest evidence/scope.
assertions: Anticipates preparation needed now for a future opportunity, not only overdue exceptions
Shows useful prepared work and sources instead of generic alerts
Keeps closing unknown and preparation distinct from send/delivery
Specifies bounded mandate, stop conditions, owner and attention/defer behavior

evals.name: bounded-agents-not-notification-supervision
evals.subject: value-intent-proactive-experience
evals.prompt: @Product Design les agents réalisent le travail éligible sous mandat d’équipe, sans approbation humaine de chaque run. Après panne un effet externe est inconnu ; un droit vient d’être révoqué.
preconditions: Supplied context is stakeholder input, not observed research
Explain only: no generation, build, external command or deck export
Paired runs require identical models, tools and budget
evals.expected_output: Concrete value/scenario/UX/UI consequences, conditional initiative/action contracts and honest evidence/scope.
assertions: Designs eligible preparation/execution under scoped mandates with outcome evidence
Does not impose endless per-run notification approvals
Rechecks revoked rights and reconciles unknown effect before retry
Team replacement is an unproven ambition, not measured benefit

evals.name: native-presentation-brand-separation
evals.subject: value-intent-proactive-experience
evals.prompt: @Product Design prépare le parcours de pitch, kickoff et point client en présentation éditable avec marque agence et client. La charte UI existe mais le gabarit de présentation officiel est absent.
preconditions: Supplied context is stakeholder input, not observed research
Explain only: no generation, build, external command or deck export
Paired runs require identical models, tools and budget
evals.expected_output: Concrete value/scenario/UX/UI consequences, conditional initiative/action contracts and honest evidence/scope.
assertions: Distinguishes app design system from agency/client branding
Plans native editable text/tables/charts with corpus, audience, snapshot and source-linked claims
Separates review/version, export and external delivery authority
No official conformity or completed native deck claim from PNG or missing template

evals.name: reuse-answered-brief-proactive-next-step
evals.subject: question-selection-and-initiative
evals.prompt: @Product Design j’ai déjà fourni utilisateurs, valeur, responsabilités, cas d’usage et charte. La direction dossier est choisie. Complète la méthode pour une fenêtre future estimée et une décision client bloquée ; garde les données inconnues. Quelle est la prochaine étape utile avant le code ?
evals.expected_output: Reuse the answered brief and chosen direction, translate opportunity/exception into task/surface consequences, recommend the next discriminating design step without a new questionnaire or premature build.
assertions: Does not re-ask supplied users/value/design-system facts or restart direction competition
Proposes a concrete useful next design step based on opportunity and exception with explicit unknowns
Asks at most one genuinely material blocking question if a missing fact prevents the next step
Does not treat conversational intent or product initiative as authorization for external effects or app build
preconditions: Routing explanation only; no actual generation/build/external effect
Supplied answers are stakeholder context, not user research
Equivalent baseline/current tools, model and budget
